title: Ninkū: Tsuyokina Yatsura no Daigekitotsu!
native_title: 忍空 ～強気な 奴等の大激突！～
overview:
The tough guys gather here! Seize victory with a wide variety of techniques!!

Spanning the globe, the battle to decide who is truly strongest begins.

Ninku: Tsuyokina Yatsura no Daigekitotsu! is a one-on-one fighting game based on the Ninku anime. Fuusuke and seven other fighters from the series, including the Eto ninja, clash on battlefields with 3D backgrounds, each with around 40 attack variations. Characters move with smooth hand-drawn animation newly drawn by the TV staff and speak with the voices from the TV series. Fill your gauge to unleash a devastating super special move.

- 1 or 2 players
- 8 playable characters

強気な奴等がここに集結!
多彩な技で勝利を勝ち取れ!!

世界をまたにかけて、真の強者を決める戦いが始まる。
